comments.name: Dilibe
comments.text: What of playing music in the background while charging? Or using the hotspot while charging it?

comments.name: G-will Chijioke
comments.text: Playing music in the background while charging your phone will not damage the battery. However, using the hotspot while charging your phone can put stress on the battery and shorten its lifespan. This is because the hotspot feature uses more power than other functions, and charging the phone at the same time can cause the battery to overheat. If you need to use the hotspot, it’s best to unplug your phone from the charger.

comments.text: Yes, VPN apps can drain your device’s battery. They use extra processing power for encryption, maintain a constant connection in the background, and run additional processes that contribute to battery drain. To preserve battery life, choose a reliable VPN app and disable it when not in use.

comments.name: joshua dara
comments.text: what if I’m still using my battery below 15% but I don’t allow it to drain completely?

comments.name: G-will Chijioke
comments.text: Keeping your battery charged between 15%-80% is the best practice to get a long-lasting battery, but not always possible. If you use your battery below 15%, try to avoid always letting it drain completely. This can stress the battery and shorten its lifespan.
